# AI Beauty Test

> AI Beauty Test is an AI-powered online tool that offers beauty scoring, age detection, and facial analysis to help users quickly understand their facial features. By combining advanced facial recognition algorithms with real-time analysis, it delivers precise and detailed results in seconds.

This website focuses on digital beauty assessments and data visualization, serving global users interested in exploring AI-based aesthetics.

## Core Content

- [Product](https://aibeautytest.org/): Our flagship AI beauty rating tool, offering features like attractiveness scoring, age prediction, and facial expression analysis.
- [Rate Me Out of 10](https://aibeautytest.org/rate-me-out-of-10): A dedicated page where users can get their "beauty score out of 10" instantly, understand the scoring criteria, and explore how AI evaluates attractiveness with transparency and precision.
